text: 1. Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens with a valid passport. 2. Be Healthy. 3. Above the age of 18 and under the age of 25 4.Have attained a senior high school diploma with good marks. 5.Have solid financial support to afford the study and living expense in China. Note: Chemistry, Physics, Biology and English are complusary subjects, Mathematics is a reference subject for admission evaluation.
